Review complete and written to [review.json](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-NF-12-argon-attempt2/.sdlc/runs/20261103-210033-feature-new-entity-rename-redirects/review.json) (`verdict: "approved"`, 0 findings).

### Passing Checks
- **Correctness**: Implements `ANNOTATION_FORMER_NAMES` (`backstage.io/former-names`), policy validation in [`FieldFormatEntityPolicy`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-NF-12-argon-attempt2/packages/catalog-model/src/entity/policies/FieldFormatEntityPolicy.ts#L147-L177), search indexing in [`buildEntitySearch`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-NF-12-argon-attempt2/plugins/catalog-backend/src/database/operations/stitcher/buildEntitySearch.ts#L221-L250), provenance-checked and conflict-safe resolution in [`DefaultEntitiesCatalog.entityByFormerRef`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-NF-12-argon-attempt2/plugins/catalog-backend/src/service/DefaultEntitiesCatalog.ts#L861-L977), OpenAPI route `GET /entities/by-former-name/{kind}/{namespace}/{name}` in [`createRouter`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-NF-12-argon-attempt2/plugins/catalog-backend/src/service/createRouter.ts#L456-L491), client methods in [`CatalogClient`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-NF-12-argon-attempt2/packages/catalog-client/src/CatalogClient.ts#L485-L495) and [`InMemoryCatalogClient`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-NF-12-argon-attempt2/packages/catalog-client/src/testUtils/InMemoryCatalogClient.ts#L626-L648), frontend redirects and banners in [`useEntityFromUrl`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-NF-12-argon-attempt2/plugins/catalog/src/components/CatalogEntityPage/useEntityFromUrl.ts#L48-L95) and [`useExternalRedirect`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-NF-12-argon-attempt2/plugins/techdocs/src/reader/components/TechDocsReaderPage/useExternalRedirect.ts#L44-L187), API reports, changeset, and documentation per [`change_plan.md`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-NF-12-argon-attempt2/.sdlc/runs/20261103-210033-feature-new-entity-rename-redirects/change_plan.md).
- **Type safety**: Strict TypeScript types across all touched packages; generated OpenAPI types and API reports are in sync.
- **Error handling**: Malformed refs caught in stitcher; auditor events properly failed and rethrown in router; missing/ambiguous/unauthorized lookups cleanly return `undefined` / HTTP 404.
- **Authz**: [`AuthorizedEntitiesCatalog.entityByFormerRef`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-NF-12-argon-attempt2/plugins/catalog-backend/src/service/AuthorizedEntitiesCatalog.ts#L134-L159) enforces `catalogEntityReadPermission` (returning `{ entity: undefined }` on `DENY` and applying the permission predicate filter on `CONDITIONAL`).
- **Test coverage**: Comprehensive unit and integration tests across `catalog-model`, `catalog-backend`, `catalog-client`, `catalog`, and `techdocs` covering happy paths, live-entity precedence, provenance verification, multi-claimant conflict rejection, permission denial, sub-path preservation, and rename notices.
